pages.text: $(italic)"It is not something that can be described in language."$()$(br2)From an exchange between O5-1 and Site-CN-25 Director Cheng Jiuzhang. What Cheng asked was: what exactly is the Throne.
pages.title: Fragment: Throne

pages.text: $(bold)Event:$() someone in the previous iteration stood before the Throne for the first time, and confirmed that it cannot be described.$(br2)$(bold)Collection:$() kept in the archive container at the base of the $(bold)End Throne$(). Reaching the site is enough.
